class.name: Adapter
class.brief_description: Base adapter that provides item Views to a RecyclerView.

method.name: _bind_item
method.description: Must override. Binds the data at [code]position[/code] onto the holder's Control.

method.name: _bind_item_with_payload
method.description: Optional. Called instead of [method _bind_item] when a change notification carries a [code]payload[/code], so only the affected part of the cell needs to be rebound.

method.name: _create_item
method.description: Must override. Creates a new [b]ViewHolder[/b] wrapping a Control for the given [code]view_type[/code]. Called when the recycled pool has no holder of that type.

method.name: _get_item_count
method.description: Must override. Returns the total number of items in the list.

method.name: _get_item_extent
method.description: Optional. Returns the item's size along the scroll axis. Values <= 0 fall back to the RecyclerView's [method RecyclerView.get_item_extent]. Defaults to 0.

method.name: _get_item_id
method.description: Optional. Returns a stable unique id for the item at [code]position[/code] (used with stable ids).

method.name: _get_item_view_type
method.description: Optional. Returns the view type of the item at [code]position[/code]. Items with different types get separate recycled-pool slots. Defaults to 0 (a single type).

method.name: _on_failed_to_recycle_view
method.description: Called when the RecyclerView is about to recycle a holder that was declared non-recyclable via [method ViewHolder.set_is_recyclable] (false). Return [code]true[/code] to force the recycle anyway; [code]false[/code] (the default) keeps the holder attached and the decision is re-visited on later layout passes. Port of Android's [b]Adapter.onFailedToRecycleView[/b] (Android triggers it via view transient state, which this port folds into [method ViewHolder.set_is_recyclable]). The holder is still attached to the RecyclerView when this is called, unlike Android where it was already removed.

method.name: _on_item_recycled
method.description: Called right before a holder leaves the view cache for the recycled pool: its data is about to be cleared and its view reused for a different item. Good place to release expensive resources (large textures, connections). The holder's [method ViewHolder.get_position] is still valid here. Not called when a holder enters the view cache (data is kept for a possible in-place reuse) nor for prefetched (never bound) views. Port of Android's [b]Adapter.onViewRecycled[/b] (dispatched from Recycler.recycleViewHolderInternal / recycleCachedViewAt).

method.name: _on_view_attached
method.description: Called when the item's Control was added to the RecyclerView's tree — a reasonable signal that the item is about to be seen by the user. Restore resources released in [method _on_view_detached] here. Fires on every re-attach (scroll back into view, reuse from the cache or pool). Port of Android's [b]Adapter.onViewAttachedToWindow[/b]; the "window" concept does not exist for Godot Controls, so the name drops it.

method.name: _on_view_detached
method.description: Called when the item's Control was removed from the RecyclerView's tree (scrolled off screen, removed, or its remove animation finished). Not necessarily permanent — the view may be cached off-screen and re-attached later. Port of Android's [b]Adapter.onViewDetachedFromWindow[/b]; the "window" concept does not exist for Godot Controls, so the name drops it.

method.name: bind_view_holder
method.description: Internal. Records the position / stable id, flags the holder bound and calls [method _bind_item].

method.name: bind_view_holder_with_payload
method.description: Internal. Rebinds with a payload via [method _bind_item_with_payload] when available, falling back to [method bind_view_holder] otherwise.

method.name: create_view_holder
method.description: Internal. Creates a holder by calling [method _create_item] and records its view type.

method.name: get_item_count
method.description: Returns the total number of items (forwards [method _get_item_count]; ListAdapter overrides it).

method.name: get_item_id
method.description: Returns the stable id of the item at [code]position[/code] (forwards [method _get_item_id]).

method.name: get_item_view_type
method.description: Returns the view type of the item at [code]position[/code] (forwards [method _get_item_view_type]).

method.name: has_observers
method.description: Returns whether any data observer is currently registered.

method.name: has_stable_ids
method.description: Returns whether stable ids are enabled.

method.name: notify_data_set_changed
method.description: Notifies observers that the whole data set changed.

method.name: notify_item_changed
method.description: Shorthand for a single-item [method notify_item_range_changed] with count 1.

method.name: notify_item_inserted
method.description: Shorthand for a single-item [method notify_item_range_inserted].

method.name: notify_item_moved
method.description: Notifies that an item moved from [code]from_position[/code] to [code]to_position[/code].

method.name: notify_item_range_changed
method.description: Notifies that [code]count[/code] items at [code]position[/code] changed content, with an optional payload.

method.name: notify_item_range_inserted
method.description: Notifies that [code]count[/code] items were inserted at [code]position[/code].

method.name: notify_item_range_removed
method.description: Notifies that [code]count[/code] items were removed starting at [code]position[/code].

method.name: notify_item_removed
method.description: Shorthand for a single-item [method notify_item_range_removed].

method.name: register_adapter_data_observer
method.description: Registers an [b]AdapterDataObserver[/b] to receive data-change notifications.

method.name: set_has_stable_ids
method.description: Enables or disables stable ids. Refusing to change while observers are registered matches the Android behavior.

method.name: unregister_adapter_data_observer
method.description: Unregisters a data observer.
